test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**agility**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the physical activity of the arboreal apes, specifically their engagement in gymnastics. The ability to move swiftly and skillfully during gymnastics is best described by the word "agility".
 
• "Agility" refers to the ability to move quickly and easily, which aligns with the context of gymnastics and physical movement.
 
• "Civility" refers to politeness and courteous behavior, which does not fit the context of physical activity described in the passage.
 
• "Density" refers to compactness or concentration, which is unrelated to the description of physical movement in the passage.
 
• "Variability" refers to the quality of being changeable, which does not fit the context of the apes' physical abilities described here.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Man, it would seem, has (1)* descended__ *from arboreal apes. They lived a happy life in tropical forests, eating coconuts when they were hungry, and throwing them at each other when they were not. They were (2)* __perpetually__ *occupied in gymnastics and acquired an (3)* __agility__ *which to us is truly (4)* __astonishing__ *. But after some millions of years of this arboreal paradise, their numbers increased to the point where the supply of coconuts was no longer (5)* __sufficient__.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Civility" does not fit the context of describing physical activity in the passage.
 
• "Density" refers to concentration or compactness, which is unrelated to the context of physical skill and movement.
 
• "Variability" refers to changeability, which does not accurately describe the agility of the apes in the passage.
